_about: v3 A1 review rows (R1). The four allow overrides below are only for the captive rows: the designer's bounded allows (beam x turntable 8.5, crown x beam 12) would otherwise hide the barb catch. Run with --only slide,sightlines --overlay-only.

allow.why: review: captive row must see the beam-hook barbs under the post ledges
review: captive row must see the crown-hook barbs under the beam pocket roof

slide_out.name: R1 v3-A1-01 beam hooks hold: beam +Z (crown, disc, jar ignored) stopped by the post ledges within 0.3
R1 v3-A1-01 crown hooks hold: crown group +Z (jar ignored) stopped by the beam pocket roofs within 0.3
R1 v3-A1-01 hub fingers hold: hub gear -Z stopped by the turntable socket ledge within 0.3
R1 v3-A1-01 valve fingers hold: valve + gate -Z off the spout (jar group lifted) stopped by the adapter within 0.3
R1 v3-A1-04 journal plate captive on its 3 crush-rib pegs: +X stopped within 1.5 at home
R1 v3-A1-04 journal plate captive on its 3 crush-rib pegs: +X stopped within 1.5 at tilt 45
R1 v3-A1-03 gate held open: from the open stop (PIV_gate 52) the blade is stopped -X within 1.0 (v2 A7 had an open notch)

sightlines.name: R1 flat-screwdriver line from the front opening reaches the right-post front beam-hook barb (25 deg off X, level)
R1 flat-screwdriver line from the rear opening reaches the right-post rear beam-hook barb (15 deg off X, level)
R1 tool line from the front opening reaches the +X crown hook tip under the beam (30 deg up)
